about_the_game:
The year is 1993. First day of summer.
You ride on your BMX with your best friend to the new arcade downtown.
Your pockets full of quarters. Life... is good.

Super Duper Arcade is a compilation of reimagined timeless arcade classics. A passionate love letter to 1980s and 1990s arcades. Chase high scores in single-player mode or go head to head with a friend to see who's worthy to call themself the Master of Arcades.

✪ A GROWING COLLECTION OF ARCADE CLASSICS ✪

In Super Duper Arcade you will find cabinets with games such as:

⮊ Space Intruders - With your powerful space cannon fend of the legions of aliens descending to Earth. Keep an eye out for that elusive Black Alien and shoot it to build up the combo meter and score multiplier!

⮊ Boom Bots - Set up bombs to break walls, find power-ups, and clear the stage to find the exit. But look out for those pesky blobs. They might look innocent, but one false move, and they'll be munching on your husk.

⮊ Flabby Birb - No amount of flapping can keep a bird who's this flabby up in the air, so prepare for an uphill battle to stay in the air. Look out for obstacles and collect shiny coins that will boost your final score.

⮊ Conga Cars - The favorite vehicular sport of the distant, dystopian future. Collect power nodes on the grid to make your trail longer, but be careful not to tie yourself up in a knot or hit anything.

⮊ PongOut! - It's not exactly Pong, but it's no Breakout either. Keep bouncing your ball to extend your side of the playfield turning each block that you hit to your own color. Make sure you're in the lead when the timer runs out!

...and more to come! - Super Duper Arcade will grow with time, adding new cabinets to the collection, following the player feedback. What do YOU want to play next?

✪ 1-PLAYER AND 2-PLAYER MODE ✪

Each game comes in classic 1-player mode and an 2-player VS mode. You will either duke it off in games like Boom Bots or Conga Cars, and PongOut! or play simultaneously to get a higher score in Space Intruders and Flabby Birb. Finally, you can challenge your friends and prove your retro-game superiority once and for all.

Language support notice:

The game is listed as "available in all languages" as it contains no text apart from the intro and main menu. It's playable for you no matter what language you speak, just like the great arcade classics used to!
